name: Tim Prokosch
title: Mathematician and researcher
introduction: I am a doctoral researcher and research associate at RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau, with a background in mathematics and web development.
about: I am pursuing a doctorate in mathematics under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Ralf Korn. My interests include financial mathematics and computational approaches to mathematical problems.
Alongside my academic work, I develop software for the web. I enjoy working between mathematical ideas and their implementation.
